title: Agentic Ticket Workflow
summary: Support-ticket agent where business rules have the final say.
problem: LLM agents happily take actions that break refund limits, SLAs and escalation policy.
solution: A durable Temporal workflow: the LLM proposes, deterministic rule checks approve or reject, risky actions wait for a human.
result: Every decision is replayable and auditable; policy violations are blocked in code, not in the prompt.
